hypothesis: Reranking can only capture the gap between pass@k and pass@1. On the 25 tasks Qwen3.6-35B-A3B never solved, that gap is small, so Jev selection should add little there. If the gap is >=8pt and selection captures most of it, reranking pays for its 3x inference; if the gap is <5pt, reranking cannot pay for itself on this distribution.
